support_desc: Follow these simple guides to connect BugAgent AI to your Atlassian Jira workspace and AI engines in under 2 minutes.
support_jira_title: How to connect Jira Cloud & Server/Data Center
support_jira_step1: Open the extension side panel and go to Settings → Jira Connection.
support_jira_step2: Enter your Jira Instance URL (e.g., https://your-company.atlassian.net or custom domain).
support_jira_step3:
For Jira Cloud: Enter your Atlassian account email and an API Token created at id.atlassian.com.
For Server/Data Center: Select Personal Access Token (PAT) and paste your token.
support_jira_step4: Click Test Jira Connection. Once verified, click Save Settings.
support_gemini_title: How to get your Google Gemini API Key
support_gemini_step1: Visit Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) and sign in with your Google account.
support_gemini_step2: Click Create API key, select your Google Cloud project (or generate a default one), and copy the generated key.
support_gemini_step3: Paste the key into Settings → Gemini Vision Key, and click Save Settings.
support_openai_title: How to get your OpenAI API Key (GPT-4o & GPT-4o-mini)
support_openai_step1: Visit the OpenAI Developer Platform (platform.openai.com) and sign in or create an account.
support_openai_step2: Click Create new secret key, give it an identifier name (e.g. BugAgent AI), and click Create secret key.
support_openai_step3: Copy your key (starts with sk-...), paste it into Settings → OpenAI Vision Key, and click Save Settings.
support_claude_title: How to get your Anthropic Claude API Key (Sonnet & Haiku)
support_claude_step1: Visit the Anthropic Console (console.anthropic.com) and sign in or create an account.
support_claude_step2: Click Create Key, give it an identifier name (e.g. BugAgent AI), and click Add.
support_claude_step3: Copy your key (starts with sk-ant-...), paste it into Settings → Claude API Key, select Claude Sonnet or Haiku, and click Save Settings.
support_ollama_title: How to use Localhost AI (Ollama - 100% Offline & Free)
support_ollama_step1: Install Ollama from ollama.com and pull a vision-capable model (e.g. ollama run moondream or ollama run llama3.2-vision).
support_ollama_step2: Launch Ollama with CORS enabled for browser extensions: on macOS/Linux run OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" ollama serve, or configure the environment variable on Windows.
support_ollama_step3: In BugAgent AI Settings, choose Localhost AI (Ollama), verify the URL (http://localhost:11434), click Fetch Models to select your vision model, and save.
